limits: Native headless Chromium SwiftShader, 1440x900, DPR1 in same 4CPU quota/16GiB environment. Not an end-user GPU FPS claim.
Draw times are CPU wall duration through rendering submission including blocking work, not GPU timer duration.

Resource prepare wall and post-prepare pre-window scene draw costs are separate. The candidate also restores the full opening presentation clock, so earlier visible phases differ from old load-skipped opening.
Only phase-matched partial windows support the same-content comparison. Initial woods age>=7 runs started at 11–15 seconds and are retained only as unmatched observations.
No whole-startup or full-game performance improvement claim, no shader/GC attribution.

fullCycle.scriptSamplingLimit: The first draw of a new loop creates a run inside native draw before its script wrapper exists. That single script call is included in draw wall but not isolated in the script samples.
